passage.label: swear city Makkah; Muhammad free restriction city; father what born him; created man hardship; thinks never anyone overcome him; says spent wealth abundance; thinks no one seen him

arabicExcerpts.text: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٞ

mainSubject.label: Oath by the sacred city of Makkah where the Prophet is free of restriction, and by the father and what he begot; man created into hardship yet thinking none will overcome him, boasting of abundant spending while assuming no one has seen him

subordinateSubjects.label: Oath sworn by this city, Makkah
The Prophet free of restriction within it
And by the father and what was born of him
Thinking that no one will ever overcome him
Boasting that he has spent wealth in abundance
Assuming that no one has seen his expenditure

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Man created into hardship yet arrogantly assuming invincibility
Wealth spent boastfully under the illusion that no one observes

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Makkah's sanctity invoked alongside the Prophet's unrestricted standing there

relationships.label: Father-and-offspring oath grounding human existence in generational continuity

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the unseen-spending assumption (7) before the sensory-gifts enumeration opens (8); P2 ends with the faith-patience-compassion cluster (17) before the two-companionship verdict begins (18); P3 covers the three-verse closing binary of right-versus-left with sealed fire (18-20).
